what_happened: Confirmed via direct read and a validated bash scratch harness that both is_contained_v10 (git-commit-scoped.sh) and its ported twin is_contained (git-commit-phase.sh) fail to match /**-suffixed file_scope entries because the entry variable is quoted inside the case pattern, disabling its own glob interpretation. A minimal added branch (parameter-expansion suffix-strip of a literal /** then ordinary prefix test) fixes both sites without widening non-glob entries; validated against 9 cases including same-prefix-sibling negatives. Task 425 confirmed independent (different site/language/root-cause, no shared helper, no file_scope overlap) -- no dependency edge needed.

The research report supplied a fully validated fix (nine-case bash scratch harness, all passing) plus exact line anchors and the existing test-harness shapes for both suites, so plan construction was transcription rather than re-derivation; no re-investigation of the root cause or the task-425 relationship was needed beyond a single confirming state.json query.

deploy-headless.sh's own fast-gate pass reported RESULT=landed_verify_red (gate10 and gate24 30s timeouts under transient high concurrent-dispatch load, plus an SC2034 shellcheck finding) during Phase 4. All three failures were confirmed to sit inside sibling task 441's own in-flight uncommitted edits (check-extension-docs.sh, sync-manifest-scripts.sh), not this task's declared file_scope. Per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive, discharged Phase 4 against the scoped narrowing invocation instead of the full verify-deploy.sh gate set.

validate-no-task-references.sh (PreToolUse Edit/Write hook) scans only the current Edit call's own new_string, not the full file. Adding new '--task 999' fixture literals to test-git-commit-scoped.sh and test-git-commit-phase.sh -- both of which already carry a file-wide task-ref-ok:begin/:end pair far above the edited region -- required wrapping each new block in its own nested task-ref-ok pair, since the far-above marker is invisible to the per-call scan.

The research report's validated fix (parameter-expansion /** suffix-strip plus prefix test, confirmed against 9 scratch probes) transcribed into the implementation with zero rework: both sites' bash -n, shellcheck, and the pre-existing test suites all passed on the first attempt after the fix was applied and correctly reordered to match the plan's specified branch placement.
